Name: Ghouls Seasonal Wizard - Vanilla and RomRas
Author: ghouls0rules
Description:
[center][b][color=#d9d2e9][size=4][u]What is this mod?[/u][/size][/color][/b][/center][center]

﻿﻿This mod is a simple visual replacer for Rasmodius the Wizard! I recently picked Stardew back up after having not played for a [i]long[/i] time, and decided to try the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073]Romanceable Rasmodius[/url]﻿ mod, as none of the bachelors really appealed to me like they used to. I also found the seasonal colours for Wizard from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] to be really cute, and was sad that there was no compatibility between the two.

So I figured, if I am going to try and make them do so, I may as well make my own Wizard replacer!

This mod comes with support for Vanilla and Romanceable Rasmodius - [b]NOT[/b] Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamped, as I have not tried that mod nor SVE - with optional seasonal appearances. If you do not wish to use the seasonal appearance, Rasmodius will use his Summer appearance all year round (the Vanilla styled one). 


[color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b][u]Requirements[/u][/b][/size][/color]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿ (for changing settings)

[color=#8e7cc3][size=4][b][u]Config[/u][/b][/size][/color]

Vanilla or RomRas Wizard - vanilla//romras - Swaps the Portraits and Sprites between Vanilla and RomRas compatible versions, default is Vanilla.

Seasonal Appearance - true//false - enables the seasonal appearance, default is False.

[color=#6fa8dc][size=4][b][u]Compatibility[/u][/b][/size][/color]

I have only tested this on 1.6, I have not tested this with earlier versions of Stardew.

To use this mod along side Romanceable Rasmodius, you must set the portrait and sprite options in RomRas's configs to 'Custom'.
To use this along side Seasonal Outfits, make sure to disable the Wizard option in its config.

Has not been tested with and likely is not compatible with Romanceable Rasmodius Redux Revamped (RRRR) or SVE, I don't use either of these mods.
